title: Repositories
description: NebulaForgeX product repos. HTTP ingress is NFX-Edge only; data plane is NFX-Stack; login is NFX-Identity.

nfxStack.description: Infrastructure: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, MinIO, Centrifugo, OTEL, OpenSearch. LAN ports 10000–10024.

nfxEdge.description: The only HTTP/HTTPS reverse proxy (Traefik) plus cert/DNS console (sites-base). Owns host 80/443. Routes are dynamic/*.project.yml. Dev: sites HTTP 10110, gRPC 10111, console 10112.

nfxIdentity.description: Central login and profiles. Forger / Authority route trees. Dev: auth HTTP/gRPC 10030/10031, console 10034. nfx-ui@0.33.0.

nfxUi.description: Shared React library: theme, layout, AuthRepository and hooks. Hosts pin 0.33.0 exactly. Do not mix file: and registry.

nfxNews.description: Go news microservices (source / news / crawl / report / notify / mcp). No local auth. Dev gRPC 10051–10061, console 10062.

nfxStorages.description: Go S3 object storage on NAS volumes. Identity issues temporary AK/SK. Dev gRPC 10081–10089, console 10090.

nfxDocumentation.description: This handbook. Canonical text lives in books/. Browser path /console/nfx-documentation/. No separate DOCS_HOST.
